changes.text: PTFX sometimes did not work; this has been fixed.
The PTFX key can now be changed in the config.
The PTFX notification has been updated.
Animations in the shared category are now listed more accurately.
Added /nearby emoteName to send an emote request to someone nearby.
Sequential animations stopped after a while instead of completing; this has been fixed.
You can now smoothly switch to another sequence animation before the current one has finished.
The keys for accepting/rejecting shared emotes and group requests can now be changed in config.lua.
Added LocalPlayer.state.currentEmote, isDoingEmote, currentWalkstyle and currentExpression, also usable on the server side.
The /sequence command was broken; this has been fixed.
Removed server-side console prints.
Emote wheel commands and exports have been added to the config.
You can now walk while the emote wheel is open.
You can now prevent the emote wheel from opening in certain situations.
Fixed the game freezing when opening the emote wheel.
Fixed GIFs not showing.

entries.title: Emote groups, radial menu and menu colours

changes.text: You can now create an emote group and invite people to it. Group members perform whatever animation the group owner performs, at the same time.
Added a radial menu (default H, can be changed in keybinds). Arrange Fortnite-style emotes page by page and quickly use, invite or cancel them.
You can now change the menu colour in settings.
Each of these features can be disabled in the config.
Added DefaultValues to the config (for example, which menu style players start with when they first join).
You could not move while using prop emotes; this has been fixed.
Fixed non-loop animations.
Fixed the sequence placeholder image.
Removed unnecessary console prints.

entries.title: Sequences, streamer mode and the v1 style menu

changes.text: Added sequences.
Added streamer mode and an option to turn GIFs on/off in settings.
Added the v1 style menu design.
Added 3 new camp chair animations and new axe and pickaxe animations.
Shared emotes now have their own category, and animations show a sign when they are shared.
Added FullBody to animSettings.
Added new animpos.
Added missing GIFs in the animal category and in general.
All non-loop animations are now looped.
GIFs now load smoothly.
Some PTFX were showing black, or the PTFX colour was not working; this has been fixed.
Animpos could leave the player inside walls; this has been fixed.
Typing in the search box no longer opens other scripts such as chat.
Fixed the handspocket, slap, carry and standbag animations.
Removed broken gang signs and props.
Removed most of the unnecessary dances.
Removed unused custom animations from the stream folder.
Fixed performance issues while the menu is closed.
Fixed a crash.
Gang signs were removed because they exceeded the stream limit.
Stream folder size reduced from 300 MB to 100 MB.
Added 20 new Fortnite dances, 50 couple poses, and 30 male and 30 female poses.
Added 250 new gang signs.
Added AfterCooldown to the config, so you can add a cooldown between animations.
Added the cylex_animmenuv2:client:onEmoteTriggered client event, triggered when an animation is clicked.
The scrollbar now stays where it was when the menu is reopened.
GIFs now load in order instead of all at once.
prone.lua is no longer escrowed.
Fixed a few bugs that caused the menu to crash.
Animpos was broken when MultipleEmotes was false; this has been fixed.
Piggyback animations are fixed.
Stream folder size reduced from 300 MB to 150 MB.
Added pointing and hands up, which can be turned on/off.
Added MaxZDistance for animpos to the config.
Categories removed from the config are now also removed from ALL and from search.
canPlayEmote was running late on shared emotes; this has been fixed.
TeleportBackOnCancel was not working properly; this has been fixed.
Added a canPlayEmote function to the config, so you can prevent players from using animations in certain situations.
Added 10 new gang weapon hold animations.
TeleportBackOnCancel could teleport the player back even when they were too far away; this has been fixed.
The menu did not close when WalkInMenu was false; this has been fixed.
Added a config setting to turn off +18 animations.
Added a config setting to turn off prop collision in prop animations.
Other players could see the prop in preview mode on prop animations; this has been fixed.
Typing /animpos while the menu was closed opened the menu; this has been fixed.
Crouching in the script reset the walking style; this has been fixed.
Removed the scrollbar in the category section.
Fixed animation positioning.
You can now choose which buttons are disabled while the menu is open via the config.
Pressing ESC to close the menu no longer opens the map.

entries.title: Big update: new couple emotes, poses and animpos improvements

changes.text: Added 98 new couple emotes and 25 new poses.
Added two new categories: Animal Emotes and Prop Emotes.
Added the /animpos [name] command and a client export to enter animpos.
Dance names can now be translated.
Dances are now sorted by number in the menu.
The category section now scrolls, so you can add as many categories as you want without breaking the design.
You can now prevent players from using animpos in certain situations via the config.
You can now turn off using animations in vehicles via the config.
You can now toggle walking on/off while the menu is open via the config.
You can now minimize the menu to the right with a button.
GIFs no longer break when an emote's name is changed.
Fixed a few ERP animations.
Fixed fall damage prevention by cancelling the scenario when punching, climbing, standing up or shooting.
Some scripts were breaking the animpos keys at the bottom right; this has been fixed.
Animpos can no longer be opened while falling.
Animpos can no longer be opened in a vehicle.
Fixed teleporting under the map while in animpos.
